title: ULDM Eigenmode Toolkit
description: Python library for computing the eigenfunctions f_nl(r) of a soliton potential and the spectral coefficients c_nlm(t) of ultralight dark matter (ULDM) wavefunctions from PyUL_SK simulations: eigen solver, one-pass a_lm kernel on radial shells, c_nlm integration (resumable pipeline and inline recording during a PyUL run), PyUL run and trajectory loaders, time/frequency analysis, and scripts that regenerate every figure of the paper Stone Skipping Black Holes in Ultralight Dark Matter Solitons (paper_figures/).
